The overview of overall indicator results tracks the performance of 13 clinical and educational metrics for ADHD assessment and treatment pathways across three reporting periods (2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25) [^src1]. The data reveals systemic challenges in meeting established clinical standards, alongside concerning downward trends in educational outcomes for youth with ADHD.

**Targets Met and Missed**
None of the indicators with a stated development target of ≥ 90% achieved this threshold in the most recent period (April 2024 to March 2025) [^src1]. The system consistently misses targets related to cross-sectoral collaboration, diagnostic conferences, and timely psychoeducation. For instance, [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] (coordinating network meetings within 90 days of treatment start) reached only 20%, and [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (diagnostic conferences with a child and adolescent psychiatrist within 120 days) reached just 27% [^src1]. 

**Leaders and Trailers**
Among the indicators bound by the ≥ 90% target, the highest performer is [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] (somatic assessment within 120 days of starting ADHD assessment), which reached 65% in 2024/25 [^src1]. The absolute lowest performer across all metrics is [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] (receipt of psychotherapy within a year when deemed relevant), which recorded a mere 1% compliance rate against its 90% target [^src1]. Other notably low performers include [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] at 20% and [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] (psychoeducation within 120 days) at 33% [^src1]. Conversely, indicators without a strict percentage target show higher baseline compliance, particularly regarding medication: [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] (patient in treatment with ADHD medication) reached 70%, and [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] reached 68% [^src1].

**Trends Across Dated Sections**
While many indicators remain relatively flat or fluctuate slightly, distinct trends emerge in specific areas. Clinical assessment metrics show some improvement: [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] (manualized diagnostic interview or environmental observation for 6-17 year-olds) rose steadily from 43% in 2022/23 to 51% in 2024/25 [^src1]. Similarly, [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] improved from 59% in 2023/24 to 65% in the latest period [^src1]. However, educational outcomes present a worrying decline. The proportion of young people in the ADHD assessment population passing the primary school leaving exam before age 17 ([[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]]) dropped from 59% in 2022/23 to 53% in 2024/25 [^src1]. The treatment population ([[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]]) saw an even steeper decline, falling from 67% to 58% over the same three years [^src1].

**Outliers**
[[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] is a massive statistical outlier; its 1% fulfillment rate stands in stark contrast to the 90% target and the 20-65% range seen in most other targeted clinical process indicators [^src1]. Additionally, the newest indicators (8 through 11), which only have data for the 2024/25 period and apply to adults, show a wide variance, ranging from 1% ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]) to 70% ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner faktisk opfyldelse af alle 13 indikatorer for tre år, hvoraf de sidste fire (8–11) kun har data for 2024–2025 og vedrører voksne — og viser almindeligvis lave opfyldelsesniveauer, især for indikatorer knyttet til tværsektorielt samarbejde og diagnostiske konferencer.

- "Indikator 9 vedrører voksne (18+ år) og er første gang opgjort uden historik og trendgraf" — see [[demographic|Demographic]] ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]) [^src13]
- "Denne indikator vedrører voksne (18+ år)." — see [[demographic|Demographic]] ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src15]
- "Indikator 2b er blevet delt i to indikatorer for at bedre afspejle to separate udredningselementer, som begge anses for vigtige i udredningen" — see [[policy-change|Policy Change]] ([[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]]) [^src6]
- "Indikator 4 er blevet udvidet til at omfatte et bredere tværsektorielt samarbejde og ændret fra behandlingsindikator til udredningsindikator med henblik på tidlig kontakt til primær sektor" — see [[policy-change|Policy Change]] ([[indikator-4|Indikator 4]]) [^src6]
- "Indikator 3 er et fokuspunkt for styregruppen i det kommende år pga. stigende patientantal, manglende speciallæger og lovgivningsændringer, der tillader specialpsykologer at stille diagnoser" — see [[governance|Governance]] ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src6]
- "Styregruppen vil ved næste styregruppemøde tage endelig stilling til om Indikator 11 i stedet skal indgå som supplerende materiale." — see [[governance|Governance]] ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src15]
- "Indikator 5 vil blive forbedret i lyset af den kommende DMPG-retningslinje om nonfarmakologisk behandling af ADHD" — see [[policy-development|Policy Development]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src6]
- "Denne stigning er især drevet af resultatet i Midtjylland på 51 %, der er en stigning på 32 procentpoint sammenlignet med året før" — see [[performance-change|Performance Change]] ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src9]
- "Syddanmark har også opnået en stigning fra 16 % i 2023/24 til 26 % i 2024/25" — see [[performance-change|Performance Change]] ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src9]
- "Den reviderede indikator har været i høring og forventes implementeret indenfor de kommende måneder" — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-4|Indikator 4]]) [^src10]
- "Styregruppen vurderer fortsat at nonfarmakologiske behandlingstiltag er vigtige for kvaliteten af behandlingen af ADHD" — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src11]
- "Styregruppen vil anvende DMPG-retningslinjen for non-farmakologisk behandling af ADHD i sit videre arbejde med Indikator 5" — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src11]
- "Udviklingsmålet for indikator 9 er ≥ 90 %" — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]) [^src13]
- "Indikator 10 har et udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 % for perioden 01.04.2024–31.03.2025" — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]) [^src14]
- "Der er intet udviklingsmål for Indikator 11." — see [[policy|Policy]] ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src15]
